programme.title: 好劇連場: 沉默的榮耀
programme.desc: 諜戰劇沉默的榮耀，真實歷史的震撼再現！劇集首次以真實姓名真實事件，將一段幾乎被時代塵埃掩埋的壯烈史詩以電視劇形式再度呈現，劇情跌宕起伏，扣人心弦ampampampampltbrampampampampgt當所有人享受著革命勝利的果實見證新中國成立的時候，有一群人，放棄了安逸的生活，在白色恐怖的籠罩下，以丹心為炬，照亮了歷史的漫漫長夜39集電視連續劇沉默的榮耀以前所未有的視角，將鏡頭對準了這些在台灣隱蔽戰線上的無名英雄，以深沉細膩的敍事手法，在語言風俗及生活場景中融合閩台文化元素，呈現台灣島在上世紀五十年代的面貌，讓觀眾彷彿穿越回到那個動盪的年代ampampampampltbrampampampampgt沉默的榮耀根據真實歷史人物吳石朱楓陳寶倉聶曦等烈士的事蹟改編，創作歷時七年，講述1949年至1950年，中共代號｢密使一號｣的台灣國防部中將參謀次長吳石，與中共華東局女情報員朱楓國防部中將陳寶倉副官聶曦等人緊密配合，多次將機密軍情傳遞給共軍，之後遭出賣而被捕吳石在牢房中用鮮血寫下台灣必歸四個大字，四人最終以為中共從事間諜活動被判死刑伏法ampampampampltbrampampampampgt此劇集結了國劇一線的實力派演員與經驗豐富的幕後團隊由盧敏為總編劇，楊亞洲執導，于和偉吳越魏晨曾黎等領銜主演憑藉強勁的製作班底，頂級演員的精湛演繹，此劇在國內開播後引發廣泛關注9月30日於央視8套開播，首日收視率破3，還曾連續18天創大陸收視第一官方宣傳該劇為獻禮國慶大劇，是新中國成立以來首部反映台灣隱蔽戰線鬥爭的重大主題影視作品

programme.title: 好劇連場: 沉默的榮耀
programme.desc: 諜戰劇沉默的榮耀，真實歷史的震撼再現！劇集首次以真實姓名真實事件，將一段幾乎被時代塵埃掩埋的壯烈史詩以電視劇形式再度呈現，劇情跌宕起伏，扣人心弦ampampampltbrampampampgt當所有人享受著革命勝利的果實見證新中國成立的時候，有一群人，放棄了安逸的生活，在白色恐怖的籠罩下，以丹心為炬，照亮了歷史的漫漫長夜39集電視連續劇沉默的榮耀以前所未有的視角，將鏡頭對準了這些在台灣隱蔽戰線上的無名英雄，以深沉細膩的敍事手法，在語言風俗及生活場景中融合閩台文化元素，呈現台灣島在上世紀五十年代的面貌，讓觀眾彷彿穿越回到那個動盪的年代ampampampltbrampampampgt沉默的榮耀根據真實歷史人物吳石朱楓陳寶倉聶曦等烈士的事蹟改編，創作歷時七年，講述1949年至1950年，中共代號｢密使一號｣的台灣國防部中將參謀次長吳石，與中共華東局女情報員朱楓國防部中將陳寶倉副官聶曦等人緊密配合，多次將機密軍情傳遞給共軍，之後遭出賣而被捕吳石在牢房中用鮮血寫下台灣必歸四個大字，四人最終以為中共從事間諜活動被判死刑伏法ampampampltbrampampampgt此劇集結了國劇一線的實力派演員與經驗豐富的幕後團隊由盧敏為總編劇，楊亞洲執導，于和偉吳越魏晨曾黎等領銜主演憑藉強勁的製作班底，頂級演員的精湛演繹，此劇在國內開播後引發廣泛關注9月30日於央視8套開播，首日收視率破3，還曾連續18天創大陸收視第一官方宣傳該劇為獻禮國慶大劇，是新中國成立以來首部反映台灣隱蔽戰線鬥爭的重大主題影視作品

programme.desc: 在一年一度的星星球科技展上，一顆蘊含超強能力的能量石被大大怪和小小怪搶走危難之際，開心超人衝動行事，導致超人聯盟失去超能力，他們也因意外而分散在不同的時空，星星球從此被危機所籠罩開心超人在飄蕩十年後歸來，發現黑暗料理大師甜心超人已成大廚嚴謹認真的小心超人變身偵探帥氣自戀的信心超人投身演藝事業，唯有粗心超人因愧疚當年的失誤，前往尋找開心超人而不知所蹤，令人十分擔心；另一邊，大大怪小小怪召集手下妄圖奪取能量石，超人聯盟穿上戰鬥服再度集結，一場大戰即將開啟

programme.desc: 一個人鐵道行 3 是一個充滿冒險精神的旅遊節目，引領觀眾搭乘鐵道探索中國各地的城市文化美景美食和人文每天用兩刻鐘，展示中國鐵路網的便捷和各地奇趣第三季我們從廣州出發，搭乘 Z264 列車，一路向西北開往西藏拉薩，耗時 54 小時，穿越中原大地和西部地區，最後抵達世界屋脊青藏高原，這是一趟橫跨東西兩端近五千公里的冒險！ 香港新生代主持阮偉倫，用一張火車票，走遍鄭州少林寺千年古都洛陽中國境內最大高原湖泊青海湖再從文化交會的西寧開始一路爬升青藏鐵路，抵達西藏，世界屋脊上的神秘淨土！

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 로보카 폴리 시즌1
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 요괴워치
programme.desc: 아주 평범한 동네, 진달래 마을에 사는 엄청 평범한 초등학교 5학년 민호는 어느 여름 날 기묘하고 하얀 생물인 위스퍼와 만나게 된다. 민호를 따라다니던 위스퍼는 신기한 시계 요괴워치를 민호에게 건네고.. 그날부터 마을 곳곳에 나타나는 요괴들이 보이기 시작한다! 일상 생활에서 벌어지는 곤란한 사건의 모든 것은 요괴가 원인이다?! 민호는 사건을 일으키는 요괴들을 설득하고 때때로는 싸우며 사건을 해결한다. 그리고 요괴들과 친구가 된다! 오늘은 또 어떤 새로운 요괴를 만나게 될까?

programme.title: 파파독
programme.desc: 늘 사랑스럽고 씩씩한 골목대장 별이. 하지만 그런 별이도 가끔은 쓸쓸한 모습을 보일 때가 있다. 그 이유는 별이의 가장 친한 친구이자 든든한 보호자가 되어 주었던 아빠가 해외 출장을 갔기 때문인데... 오늘도 홀로 가방을 챙기고 학교로 향하는 별이, 그런데 왠 개 한마리가 앞을 가로 막는다. 별이를 보며 반갑다는 듯 꼬리를 흔들던 개! 갑자기 두발로 일어나더니 사람처럼 말을 하기 시작하는데... 별아, 내가 니 아빠다, Im your farther! 어이없는 상황에 눈이 휘둥그래진 별이, 그리고 감정이 북받치는 듯 눈물을 흘리는 개! 과연 어떻게 된 일일까?? 배꼽 잡는 소동과 따뜻한 가족의 사랑이 담긴, 아빠가 개가 됐어요!, 개 변신 애니시트콤 파파독의 이야기가 시작된다.

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 大漢天子III
programme.desc: 雄主登巔野心不減 帝國極盛暗藏風雲步入中年的漢武帝，稱帝二十餘年，驅伊稚部落於漠北，削諸藩而一統，富國強兵，使大漢王朝進入了輝煌鼎盛時期 永不滿足的漢武帝，不斷設計自己的人生藍圖他聯合西域，穩定北疆，再無後顧之憂；又將目光轉向南越，意在建成最強大的大漢王朝在一批股肱之臣紛紛下世後，武帝大膽起用漢室新一代棟樑，他們抱著新的理想，摩拳擦掌欲展開年輕一代的故事同時，武帝痛感到光陰催人，理想遠大而天不永年，對長生不老的追求也越來越急迫

programme.title: 楚喬傳
programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.title: 牧野詭事之尋龍
programme.desc: 摸金後人胡不昧，一心想攢錢去尋找失蹤的哥哥，他和逃兵老雷前往無子村做棺材，等待他們的正是當年和哥哥一起下墓的彭三爺，此時木材行的大小姐朱砂前來討債，抓走彭三爺，胡不昧為求真相出手相助，朱砂要求胡不昧隨她去救弟弟，胡不昧只得同意下墓，而在墓中等待眾人的卻是意想不到的兇險

programme.title: 唐門之神犼雙雄
programme.desc: 唐門門主過世，二十年前的事再次掀起江湖紛爭，各方勢力針鋒相對，中原質子唐離與唐門少主唐天行，少女唐心陷入風暴的中心，一場圍繞兩個少年身世的秘密逐漸浮現，在各大門派的追殺中，二十年的武林大戰再次發生

programme.title: 歲月風雲之上海皇帝
programme.desc: 陸月生本是小販出身，因用流氓手法偵破宋教仁被刺案而聲名大噪，受到法租界總探長黃全榮賞識，從此平步青雲，依附軍閥勢力，逐步攀升成為上海大亨但好景不長，1927年，上海迎來前所未有的社會動盪與政治鉅變，軍閥割據，民不聊生，國共反目，工人造反，陸月生最終被國民黨利用，參與了反對鎮壓工人武裝的鬥爭與屠殺共產黨人的陰謀

programme.title: 上海皇帝之雄霸天下
programme.desc: 1930年代，陸月生黃全榮及袁嘯軍合稱上海三大亨此時的上海一步步成為國共兩黨內部的戰場，加上日軍野心勃勃，社會瀰漫著軍變前的恐慌陸月生感到前途茫茫，希望藉國民黨的力量在政治上找尋出頭機會然而在狡詐的政治舞台，其背景反成為被攻擊的把柄，一代梟雄失意後一病不起含恨而終

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍鐧，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天走向權力之路最大的威脅同時，洛陽城發生諸多離奇事件面對空前危機，狄仁傑要如何保住亢龍鐧？

programme.title: 青面修羅

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: 老丁曾是個功力深厚的軍人，退休後某日帶外孫女到公園玩時，竟讓外孫女走失，家人難以釋懷也不再往來自責的老丁失智症狀更為嚴重，獨自在東北邊境生活，鄰居李政久的女兒小春花勾起老丁對外孫女的記憶，一老一小成了忘年之交但李政久卻捲入中俄黑幫大仇殺，小春花被綁架，老丁決定挺身而出，尋回軍人的驕傲及彌補身為爺爺的過錯，他能否以一人之力擊退黑幫，救回小春花呢？

programme.title: 花田囍事
programme.desc: 小霸王周通與妹周吉時常惹事淩人，其母太君為使二人定性，決要二人各自成親吉與指腹為婚的林嘉聲被迫入贅周家，林嘉聲於洞房夜逃走，巧遇母夜叉相助通找魔術師高柏輝於太君壽宴中表演，正值花田燈會中，輝邂逅白家獨女白雪仙，通偶然得睹雪仙芳容，驚為天人，硬要娶雪仙過門，於重重誤會下，弄成笑話百出

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神

programme.title: 黑幫啟示錄

programme.title: 警察故事續集

programme.title: 至尊無上

programme.title: 伯尼小海豚

programme.title: 星際特工瓦雷諾：千星之城

programme.title: 加菲貓：農場大冒險新

programme.title: 烽火連天

programme.title: 終極殺陣3

programme.desc: 加菲貓過著舒服的家庭生活，某天竟突遭綁架，加菲貓與牠的狗狗夥伴歐弟，與失散多年的父親放蕩不羈的流浪街貓維克意外重逢，壞壞貓咪金珂絲因不滿維克的背叛而策劃綁架，並脅迫加菲貓前往農場偷取牛奶，補償金珂絲的損失，加菲貓只好連同歐弟維克進行風險極高又充滿滑稽的牛奶偷竊行動！

programme.title: 惡水真相
programme.desc: 美國戰地攝影家尤金史密斯在二戰過後決定隱居，與社會和職業脫節，但生活雜誌編輯羅伯特海斯帶他來到日本熊本的水俁市，那是一個因日本窒素公司排放廢棄物而造成汞中毒的城市史密斯用相機紀錄人們受水俁病所苦的症狀，以及為公義所付出的努力他用一張張震懾人心的相片，為國際揭開這場令人心碎的歷史災難，也改變了當地居民的人生

programme.title: 蝙蝠俠1966
programme.desc: 高譚市四大惡徒：貓女企鵝人謎天大聖小丑，這次他們一起聯手結盟，駕著擁有洲際飛彈的企鵝核動力潛艇，劫持了一艘正駛往高譚市載有最新脫水科技儀器的遊艇這次，壞蛋們除了要除掉蝙蝠俠和羅賓的正義二人組外，最終目標是即將在高譚市召開的聯合國九大安理會員國會議，欲藉機控制全球！蝙蝠俠和羅賓該如何將四大惡徒繩之以法拯救世界呢？

programme.title: 馬永貞
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 死神騎馬來
programme.desc: 十五年前的梅斯塔牧場，比爾一家人慘遭搶匪集團滅門，只有小比爾被一名晚到搶匪藏於馬車下而逃過一劫親眼目睹家人慘死的比爾，多年來苦練槍法一心復仇，在追查的過程中遇上甫出獄的中年牛仔瑞恩，兩人似乎有著共同的目標，帶著既像競爭又像合作的方式將匪徒逐一揪出擊斃，而比爾也漸漸發現瑞恩其實隱藏著一段秘密

programme.title: 黃飛鴻II之男兒當自強
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與十三姨梁寬在廣州遇到白蓮教徒借扶清滅洋口號，搗亂使館教堂等洋人地盤，連就讀洋校的小學生也不放過，原來是大臣納蘭元述包庇用來對付革命黨黃在一醫學會議中，與革命領袖孫文一見如故，發覺他們對救國更具遠見，決助他們一把逃過厄運，但白蓮教徒卻苦苦相逼

programme.title: 追男仔
programme.desc: 單親爸爸程勝獨力撫養三個女兒長大成人，假稱患上絕症對女兒們催婚精英女警與男公關善良社工與古惑仔醫生與純情少爺，三對冤家笑料百出，是否能修成正果呢？

programme.title: 大洪荒
programme.desc: 公元前百萬年的遠古時代，高原洞穴中的岩石部落，首領阿可荷巴的次子托馬克因不服父親搶奪自己的食物而遭驅逐，流浪至海邊被較文明的貝殼族所救他因奮勇擊退巨獸而為貝殼族所擁戴，並受該族美女羅安納仰慕，而後率領貝殼族人歷經千辛萬苦回到岩石部落，卻人事已非其兄長沙卡納謀害父親並繼任成為新的首領，而高原上的火山也即將爆發

programme.title: 馬永貞
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 荒野大鏢客
programme.desc: 位處美墨邊境荒涼的墨西哥小鎮，來了一位總是叼著根雪茄煙槍法神準的大鏢客鎮上有巴特幫洛荷幫兩大幫派，專門販賣私械私酒，兩幫長期廝殺，魚肉鎮民，弄得鎮民們是妻離子散，家破人亡出於正義，大鏢客運用計謀讓雙方展開火拚，最終將小鎮的惡勢力全數消滅

programme.title: 教父
programme.desc: 二戰後的紐約黑手黨柯里昂家族，是以賭博走私和操控工會的黑幫企業，首領維多嚴守傳統黑幫道德準則，拒絕販售敗壞人心的毒品被人尊為教父而其他黑手黨家族為謀求更高利益的毒品生意，希望在警政界具影響力的維多加入經營被拒後，一場腥風血雨的黑幫血拚暗殺，正襲向維多的柯里昂家族

programme.title: 革命前夕的摩托車日記
programme.desc: 這是切格瓦拉成為傳奇革命英雄之前的故事23歲的醫學院學生埃內斯托格瓦拉與生化學家好友阿爾貝托，跳上老舊的重機，從家鄉布宜諾斯艾利斯出發，展開一場貫穿南美大陸的壯闊之旅，目睹了這片土地所承受的創傷苦難與種族剝削，在青年格瓦拉的心裡埋下了日後改造世界的革命之火本片入圍金球獎最佳外語片，由中央車站巴西大導華特沙勒斯執導

programme.title: 諜報飛龍
programme.desc: 三位懷抱理想的科學家創立銀河黨，欲創造一個和諧世界，他們以控制天氣來恐嚇全球順應理想，若不從便將其港口城市淹沒各國領袖齊聚美國商討對策，其特務卻一一被滅口，而電腦分析出唯一能勝任反恐任務的特務，唯有一名我行我素的麻煩人物：德瑞克弗林特美國總統親自熱線下令，弗林特憑藉一身絕技與高科技秘密武器，最終直搗黃龍摧毀銀河黨

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 朋友再見
programme.desc: 自阿爾及利亞戰場歸來，法國醫官巴宏和外籍軍團傭兵波普同在營區等待除役而相識，種下了莫名的兄弟情誼巴宏為了完成軍中友人生前承諾，答應其女友伊莎貝爾，利用即將到來的聖誕長假潛入公司保險櫃放回一筆價值不菲的債券，波普也恰在同時找上巴宏，二人竟被鎖在公司金庫中！原來看似單純的偷天換日計劃其實是場大騙局，哥倆好陷入謀殺劫案中，該如何信守男人間的約定來扭轉頹勢？

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: 六八年夏天，姓高紗廠老闆敗賭而致家破人亡他的八歲兒子高進從此喪失家園，加入了老千集團跟靳學一切千門技術，十七歲已成為獨當一面的老千高手後來在一次賭神大賽中被師父出賣，並遭槍擊，好友七姑娘與于於在混戰當中受了重傷，高進在連番打擊下決定與師兄傲及靳在賭場上決一死戰

programme.title: 新少林五祖
programme.desc: 清朝康熙年間，少林俗家弟子洪熙官被同門師兄馬寧兒出賣，全家慘遭殺害，洪熙官刺死馬寧兒後，與唯一倖存的幼子浪跡天涯八年後，少林遭劫難，至菩禪師將藏寶圖紋在五個年幼的的俗家弟子背上，並委託洪熙官護送他們前往紅花會不料馬寧兒當年並沒有死，還成了刀槍不入的怪物，他殺害了紅花會總舵主，並追殺五個孩子

programme.title: 時光機器
programme.desc: 19世紀的英國發明家喬治搭著自己發明的時光機器前往未來，期盼未來會是和平世界，但實際上卻戰爭不斷當他來到最遙遠的未來，發現此時只剩下生活在地面的艾諾伊族，與生活在地底並以艾諾伊族為食的莫勒克族喬治挺身帶領艾諾伊族反抗，並協助他們重新建立文明

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 633轟炸大隊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，挪威反抗軍領袖艾利克冒死劫機逃至英國，帶來德軍在挪威秘密研發飛彈準備對盟軍展開致命攻擊的情報英軍命令格蘭特指揮官的蚊式戰鬥轟炸機633中隊，執行摧毀德軍隱身在挪威險峻峽灣飛彈工廠的任務艾利克奉命返回挪威帶領反抗軍破壞保護工廠的防空陣地，卻不幸被蓋世太保所擄並遭嚴刑拷問；消息傳回英國，為避免任務曝光急命633中隊全員出動救援

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 特映電影-開心鬼
programme.desc: 一名多次赴考未中狀元的古人，懸樑自盡後附於麻繩上，而意外來到八十年代，遇上一群女學生成為好友，也因此鬧出許多笑話

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂完
programme.desc: 2023紅星大獎獲最佳電視劇 自閉症家庭的家人間扶持溫馨勵志小品鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天

programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: Bonjour麵包店新
programme.desc: 車勝元金宣虎金喜愛強強聯手！全韓首間銀髮族專屬療癒咖啡廳 開幕當頂級影星遇上銀髮族長輩，一場最療癒的化學反應即將發生！Bonjour麵包店 將場景搬移至寧靜鄉村，打造全韓首間專屬長者的咖啡廳這裡不只販售甜點，更分享故事由金喜愛金宣虎組成超暖心服務組，用溫柔對話與親切笑容治癒每位長輩；廚房則由萬能主廚車勝元攜手李基澤，將在地食材化作精緻藝術品看這群大咖藝人如何陪伴長者細數人生軌跡，在麵包香氣中傳遞溫暖

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 女王之家完
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: Bonjour麵包店
programme.desc: 車勝元金宣虎金喜愛強強聯手！全韓首間銀髮族專屬療癒咖啡廳 開幕當頂級影星遇上銀髮族長輩，一場最療癒的化學反應即將發生！Bonjour麵包店 將場景搬移至寧靜鄉村，打造全韓首間專屬長者的咖啡廳這裡不只販售甜點，更分享故事由金喜愛金宣虎組成超暖心服務組，用溫柔對話與親切笑容治癒每位長輩；廚房則由萬能主廚車勝元攜手李基澤，將在地食材化作精緻藝術品看這群大咖藝人如何陪伴長者細數人生軌跡，在麵包香氣中傳遞溫暖

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相

programme.title: 婚姻結業式2
programme.desc: 黃美惠當了28年的家庭主婦之後，終於和老公鎮邦達成卒婚的協議，搬出來自己住，但是初戀情人駱誠卻無法離開老婆，於是接受企業家林總的追求老公鎮邦幾經掙扎，終於遞出離婚協議書，美惠在確認綾香愛鎮邦之後，便與鎮邦離婚

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 婚姻結業式2
programme.desc: 黃美惠當了28年的家庭主婦之後，終於和老公鎮邦達成卒婚的協議，搬出來自己住，但是初戀情人駱誠卻無法離開老婆，於是接受企業家林總的追求老公鎮邦幾經掙扎，終於遞出離婚協議書，美惠在確認綾香愛鎮邦之後，便與鎮邦離婚

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 落難千金嫁到三位惡婆婆家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪

澳洲滋味精選英
programme.desc: 有說肉批是澳洲的國菜，於是崇明和阿寶前去塔斯曼尼亞，從擁有最清新空氣的西岸，走到隱藏塔斯曼尼亞最大秘密的北陲，最後炮製一道挺高級的經典澳洲肉批他們還提出極具爭議的問題：要不要配醬汁吃？

programme.title: 貼地鐵路遊英
programme.desc: 今集，米高和韋爾來到愛德華王子島省他們去找鐵路遺跡，去見識最出名的省產物：馬鈴薯接著他們出海釣魚，跟加拿大海岸防衛隊訓練千萬別錯過加拿大唯一的旋轉屋，並跟他們烘焙班諾克麵包和做煙燻蠔

programme.title: 穹蒼下的世界英
programme.desc: 今集介紹北英格蘭這裏是工業革命發祥地，區內有三個偉大的工業城市，也有風景優美的鄉郊，包括峰區的荒野沼澤湖區的人間仙境另外有不少古堡傳統鐵路和美輪美奐的鄉村大宅

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 愛迪嘉芙和德倫對戰Stanley餐廳的路易提卡蘭團隊，他們要面對一場零溝通的接力賽，各人有25分鐘烹煮本為Stanley隊率先上陣，做脆皮雞蒸魚和白菜；德倫亦以亞洲式蒸鯛魚椰香飯和沙律應戰他們能否成功？

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英
programme.desc: 布倫露和費奧迎戰Serai餐廳的羅斯馬耐尼團隊；他們最多有75分鐘時間下廚，可選用多達12組材料，最佳菜式可為團隊爭勝費奧和里安祖率先下廚，有59分鐘炮製菜式，而等至最後的布倫只得31分鐘下廚爭勝

programme.title: 狗狗老友記英
programme.desc: 舒默斯是一隻獲救的山地犬，卻與一隻被家裡其他貓排斥的緬因貓結成好友在達拉斯動物園，阿馬尼是一隻典型的聰明友善外向的黑色拉布拉多犬，與牠的朋友 : 一隻膽小焦慮的獵豹溫士貝情投意合

programme.title: 靠近我一點普

programme.title: 行運一條龍粵普

programme.title: 無雙粵普

However, it was Northern Ireland who took the honours when they last faced off in a competitive fixture, claiming a 2-0 win in the group stage of UEFA Euro 2016 thanks to strikes by Gareth McAuley and Niall McGinn. programme.title: Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Lets play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, hed still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tais best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion. Award winning actor Ku Feng is his eq

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the governments secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperors ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named Wind and Cloud could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his fathers death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late fathers friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.desc: Moray attacks the hauler with an EMP sending it into emergency lockdown and trapping the team inside. Now, its up to Roscoe, the only one small enough to fit through a vent, to find help. Meanwhile, Palindrome hunts down Moray using the evidence gathered by Ms. Nowhere.

programme.title: Into the Labyrinth
programme.desc: In order to stop Morays plan of directing a lava flow through Mexico City, the team must navigate through the underground tunnels and find his secret lair. But first they have to get their cars back from the DMV! Once they accomplish that, they learn that tunnels are much more complicated than they appear and Tony makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to help them stop Moray in time.

programme.title: Dont Go Chasing Lavafalls
programme.desc: Palindrome has been captured, Tony is gone, and Moray has activated his lava machine. The team starts to accept defeat, until Tony reveals that hes still alive! The team rallies behind this good news and launches one last attack to defeat Moray once and for all and stop the lava heading for the streets of Mexico City.

programme.title: Family On The Edge
programme.desc: When Dagur comes to Dragons Edge looking for Heather, Hiccup tries to keep the two siblings apart by teaching Dagur the art of Dragon Riding.

programme.title: Last Auction Heroes
programme.desc: When the Riders uncover the location of Viggos Dragon Auction, they must stop him from selling dragons and stealing all the gold in Berk.

programme.title: Defenders Of The Wing Part 1
programme.desc: The Defenders of the Wing are a local island tribe, which worships dragons and believe the Riders have stolen their protector the Eruptodon dragon.

programme.title: A Matter Of Perspective
programme.desc: The Riders follow the aging Eruptodon to the sacred Dragon Graveyard, but soon find themselves trapped by the fearsome Sentinel dragons who guard the graveyard

programme.title: Return Of Thor Bonecrusher
programme.desc: When Thor Bonecrusher is needed to rescue hostages taken by the Bandits, Snoutlout tries to help but accidentally brings to life Thors evil twin Anti-Thor who sides with the Bandits

programme.title: Dawn Of Destruction
programme.desc: When Hiccup and Astrid go away for a weekend, the Edge is attacked by Krogan, Viggo, and their new Dragon Flyers

programme.title: The Wings Of War Part 1
programme.desc: Hiccup and the riders are on the run from the Flyers, but when they return to Berk, where Stoick is preparing for war, Hiccup is torn between his desire to get the Edge back and his unwillingness to fire on dragons

programme.title: The Wings Of War Part 2
programme.desc: When Stoick decides to take the battle on the Dragon Flyers to the Edge, the Riders must figure out how to trap the Flyers and take back the Edge

programme.title: No Dragon Left Behind
programme.desc: After being ambushed by aggressive Slitherwing dragons on a new island, the Riders think Stormfly has been poisoned and race to get an antidote

programme.title: Snuffnut
programme.desc: Tuff fakes his own death to make room for Throk, but when Ruff tries to train the Changewing that she thinks ate Tuff, a flock of angry Changewings come for the dragon

programme.title: MEGA Fights Sergio Gabriel Martinez vs. Serhiy Dzinziruk
programme.desc: This episode features a bout for the vacant WBC diamond middleweight title, as Sergio Gabriel Maravilla Martinez 46-2, 25 KOs takes on fellow southpaw Serhiy Dzinziruk, aka Dzyna Razor 37-0. 24 KOs. This fight took place from Foxwoods Resort Casino in Mashantucket, Connecticut, USA, on March 12, 2011. Martinez was the reigning Fighter of the Year coming into the fight and vacated his WBC Middleweight title in order to fight the undefeated former champion Dzinziruk.

programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Bernard Hopkins facing off with Chad Dawson in a light heavyweight championship rematch from their controversial October 2011 bout. Also on the card, action from former welterweight champ James Kirkland.

programme.title: Greatest Classics Vinny Pazienza vs. Gilbert Dele
programme.desc: In this episode, we see The Pazmanian Devil Vinny Pazienza in front of his hometown crowd in Providence, Rhode Island, taking on undefeated WBA Super Welterweight World Champion Gilbert Dele of France. The raucous crowd was firmly in favor of its local hero, cheering him on as he looked to win his second World Title, having lost the first one to Greg Haugen three years earlier. programme.title: How the Wild Things Sleep
programme.desc: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 2
programme.desc: Avoid the swords, spikes, and deadly hood ornaments on these alpha hunters. Observe elands locking corkscrew horns, storks rattling sabre-shaped beaks, rhinos scaring the competition with massive horns, and striped marlins spearing unsuspecting prey.

programme.title: Ocean Parks Season 1
programme.desc: Deep in the South Caribbean Sea, explore the protected waters of Bonaire National Marine Park, home to thriving reefs, endangered sea turtles, sprawling mangroves, and a plethora of marine life.

programme.title: Baboons: Rules of the Troop
programme.desc: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive the Greater One-horned Rhino.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies and raising them is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered pests. But their very survival may depend on finding a home where theyre not welcome.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: Theres strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, its the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

programme.desc: 警长骆英财被派往调查被埋没八年的尸体发现案随着警长锁定疑犯，一名检控官也参与调查想要找出案件的真相在质问警长之下，检控官更发现他的行为有疑，因他对案件的陈述前后不一，充满疑点...

programme.title: 第一炉香Love After Love
programme.desc: 电影由许鞍华导演，改编自张爱玲的首部短篇小说三十年代，年青女学生葛薇龙离乡别背井从上海到香港求学，因生活拮据，求助姑妈代交学费，却被姑妈利用，成为上流社会社交游戏的诱饵当她爱上花花公子乔琪乔时，正是她堕落的开始

programme.title: 热血燃烧Burning Blood
programme.desc: 缉毒精英陈泰桦老米阿峰与阿棠奉命秘密缉捕跨国毒枭，却因队内黑警泄密，行动甫展开便落入圈套阿峰当场殉职，队长卢Sir壮烈牺牲，阿棠则神秘失踪，兄弟情谊自此崩离多年后，幸存的陈泰桦与老米誓要查明真相，连手追缉潜伏多年的内鬼，为牺牲的兄弟讨回血债

programme.title: 谈判专家Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: 谈判专家卓文伟被陷害成杀警案的主脑，于是他冒着一切风险绑架警察，坚称要与前谈判专家谢家俊进行对话在这场智力与心理的激烈对决中，两人的思维逐渐交错，展开了一场高智商的斗智斗力较量

programme.title: 巴黎假期Paris Holiday
programme.desc: 带着破碎的心，林俊杰离开香港到法国巴黎展开新生活他透过房屋中介找到理想公寓，可是公寓却附带了一位失恋艺术家丁晓敏两个毫不相干的人住在同一屋檐下，开展了一段微妙的同居生活两人在磨擦失落体谅中互相窥探了对方最脆弱的内心，他们可否放下过去包袱，重燃对生命的热情？两人酿造的友谊又能否引领二人开花结果？

programme.title: 恶行之外Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: 督察乐一言的独生女惨遭杀害，她的同班同学邱俊文因此被捕乐一言原以为案件已告一段落，于是黯然离开警队然而，邱俊文入狱后，接连又有多名女孩遭遇不测此时，乐一言开始怀疑真正的凶手仍逍遥法外，并誓要查明真相

programme.title: 内幕Under Current
programme.desc: 慈善巨头济拔堂晚会突发命案，财务总监离奇吊死，两亿善款凭空蒸发大律师马迎风卷入风暴，被迫与警探柯定邦联手调查随着真相逐渐揭开，他们发现善款背后竟隐藏着洗黑钱与买凶杀人的黑暗利益网

programme.title: 百万红包A Good Fortune
programme.desc: 新加坡网红开心误坠诈骗，与母亲逃往马来西亚躲债，并重逢旧同学子豪为摆脱财务危机，两人阴差阳错地携手参加百万奖金菠萝挞大赛，在笑料百出的挑战中追寻人生福气

programme.title: 私家侦探Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: 私家侦探欧阳伟业在办案途中意外发现妻子出轨，震惊之下，他放弃了另一宗失踪人口案的追查不久，该失踪者被发现遇害，警员陈康民怀疑背后潜藏连环杀手为阻止凶手再次犯案，欧阳伟业必须凭借侦探直觉，力挽狂澜

programme.title: 赴汤蹈火Relentless Fury
programme.desc: 暗影小队队长林朗率领雇佣兵团队，接获高危任务，要护送一名神秘女子平安返家她是暗网史上悬赏最高的目标，重赏之下，全球顶尖杀手蠢蠢欲动，恶名昭彰的国际通缉犯Roy亦现身追杀如今，林朗与队友们唯有拼死一搏，才能完成任务

programme.title: 无名指My First of May
programme.desc: 前壁球冠军邓叔彦与妻子正面临人生的严峻考验，就是女儿罹患罕见脊椎疾病，母亲也同时确诊癌症多年后，当这个家庭在坚持与放弃之间挣扎时，一个微小却充满力量的希望悄然出现 女儿尾指轻轻颤动，让他们重新找回了彼此的连结

programme.title: 里应外合Inexternal
programme.desc: 兽医职员泽明因一场医疗纠纷陷入死局，在生死一线间，他坠入了梦境与神话交织的超现实维度神秘老人的指引并未终结危机，反而将他推向一场残酷的魔幻生存考验往事的回响与异界的谜团交织缠绕，泽明在虚实交错的血色斗争中寻求觉醒

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 2
programme.desc: Go scavenging with natures cleanup crew. See Tasmanian devils get into food fights with rivals learn how dung beetles roll over the competition view wild boars fierce mating strategies and watch hyenas bone-crushing teeth demolish any meal.

programme.title: Ocean Parks Season 1
programme.desc: This episode examines the importance of three marine habitat types in the Florida Keys including the animals within them and conservationists efforts to protect them.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo Season 1
programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo Season 1
programme.desc: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but bringing up baby is fraught with challenges. Predators, climate extremes, and lively joeys mean kangaroo mothers face a daily struggle to keep their young alive.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo Season 1
programme.desc: Follow several different males as they roam the land, climb up the social ladder, and fight for their mating rights in Eastern Grey colony. For these bucks, the drive to perpetuate their species promises a life full of risk and reward.

programme.title: Wild Crusades Season 1
programme.desc: The forests of Yala National Park are home to the enigmatic sloth bear. Shy by nature, this animal is seldom seen and rarely filmed. Join a team of wildlife filmmakers as they reveal this mysterious bears life and behaviour as never seen before.

programme.title: Wild Crusades Season 1
programme.desc: Theres a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.

programme.title: Wild Crusades Season 1
programme.desc: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittus is on a quest to understand their complex society.

programme.title: The Living Beach Season 1
programme.desc: Get ready to understand the science behind Hawaiis stunning beaches. Why does sand appear white, yellow, black, green and red? How do active volcanoes change the coastline? Are other forces at play in shaping these incredible beaches?

programme.title: The Living Beach Season 1
programme.desc: Its a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the largest sand island on earth, and home to wild dingoes, six-foot sand-worms, and eucalyptus woodlands. Find out how everything lives happily together in a complex ecosystem built entirely upon sand.

programme.title: The Living Beach Season 1
programme.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living on the living beach?

programme.title: Macaque Island Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

programme.title: Macaque Island Season 1
programme.desc: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Stake out the Bay Familys lush territory, where matriarch Anna offers lavish feasts but faces internal dissent. Size up her rival Mia, the streetwise Townies leader whos eyeing a lifestyle upgrade, and check in with the isolated Mangrove Family.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Swim upriver with the Bay Family, where Anna offers a hand raising her grandpups before heading home to find interlopers on her turf. Watch a flood in the mangroves nearly sweep away a baby, and see the Townies eat clean through their resources.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome Annas clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Annas scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

programme.title: 啟航！大運河Go! Grand Canal

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季Singing With Legends Season 5 Repackaged

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.desc: Kisah ahli perniagaan London yang rendah hati Quan, yang masa lalunya yang telah lama terkubur meletus dalam dendam yang didorong oleh dendam apabila satu-satunya orang yang ditinggalkan untuk dicintainya - anak perempuan remajanya - diambil daripadanya dalam tindakan keganasan bermotif politik yang tidak masuk akal . Dalam pencarian tanpa henti untuk identiti pengganas, Quan terpaksa terlibat dalam konflik kucing-dan-tikus dengan seorang pegawai kerajaan Ireland, yang masa lalunya mungkin mengandungi petunjuk tentang identiti pembunuh yang sukar difahami.

programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang
programme.desc: Darma trauma dengan bunuh diri tunangnya, Rose, yang telah dihantui oleh makhluk halus jahat. Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Terkejut dengan kejadian bunuh diri itu, Darma bekerjasama dengan adik kembar Rose, Seri, untuk menyiasat. Semasa mereka menyiasat, pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku, menyebabkan keadaan mental Darma semakin merosot dan memberi kesan kepada kerjayanya. Dia pulang ke kampung untuk berehat, tanpa disedari semakin hampir dengan kebenaran. Akhirnya, terungkap bahawa nenek Darma secara tidak sengaja telah mengundang roh yang dikenali sebagai Saka ke dalam rumah mereka, satu roh yang menghantui keturunan pemiliknya selepas kematian.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Mean Talk

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue

Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group MYNTSabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lodeeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macaus unique leisure bus routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched Macau History Exploration Guide, allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.
